src/dispatchers/ATokenDispatcherV2.sol.role: abstract base of UniPoolerV2, PromotionUniV2_Eth, NudgeRatchetDelayRelease, NudgeRatchet, BalancerPoolerV2, Uniboost

entryPoints.dispatch(minter, amount, extraData): external nonReentrant onlyMinter whenNotPaused; calls _dispatch then hook.onDispatch(minter, amount, extraData) (hook call is NOT failure-isolated)

state: hook (default: DefaultDispatchHook deployed in ctor - a no-op)
src/dispatchers/ATokenDispatcherV2.sol.keyFact: Default hook is a no-op: any concrete dispatcher without a hook-type guard fails OPEN (zero debt) if setHook is forgotten (M-04 class).

_executeMint(index, recipient, extraData: safeTransferFrom(msg.sender -> dispatcher, price) with balance-delta measurement -> actualReceived
price grows by growthBasisPoints BEFORE dispatch (CEI)
_mint(recipient, index, 1, "") - ERC1155 mint => onERC1155Received callback to attacker-controllable recipient AFTER payment, price update and dispatch are final (inbound-callback site for Tier 2)
adminPaths: replaceDispatcher(index, newDispatcher) onlyOwner - the index-4 BalancerPoolerV2 -> UniPoolerV2 cutover path
src/NFTMinterV2.sol (dispatch path only).trustNotes: dispatch amount = actualReceived (FOT-adjusted); replaceDispatcher does not touch hooks - hook rewiring is a separate owner step on the dispatcher and on the hook.

src/hooks/BalancerPoolerMintDebtHook.sol.role: mint-debt hook expected at index 4 (BalancerPoolerV2 today; UniPoolerV2 after cutover)
src/hooks/BalancerPoolerMintDebtHook.sol.onDispatch: require(msg.sender == dispatcher) else revert OnlyDispatcher; mintDebt += amount*ratio/100 (ratio <= MAX_RATIO 50, default 50); amount is 18dp USDS for poolers
src/hooks/BalancerPoolerMintDebtHook.sol.pull(): onlyOwnerOrRecipient nonReentrant; mints full mintDebt phUSD to recipient
src/hooks/BalancerPoolerMintDebtHook.sol.setDispatcher(address): onlyOwner, non-zero - MUST be repointed to UniPoolerV2 at cutover (or a fresh hook deployed)
src/hooks/BalancerPoolerMintDebtHook.sol.hookTypeId: ABSENT - so UniPoolerV2 cannot use a NudgeRatchet-style type guard without a hook change (see UniPoolerV2 LOCAL-UP-001)

cutoverFailureModes.setHook forgotten on UniPoolerV2: fail-OPEN: mints succeed, zero debt accrues
cutoverFailureModes.hook.setDispatcher not repointed: fail-LOUD: every index-4 mint reverts OnlyDispatcher

src/hooks/NudgeRatchetMintDebtHook.sol.role: mint-debt hook for NudgeRatchet and NudgeRatchetDelayRelease (separate instances)
src/hooks/NudgeRatchetMintDebtHook.sol.onDispatch: dispatcher-gated; accrues scaled debt (M-03 decimal fix in place - scale for 6dp USDC); returns early on zero
